description_en: Queries the current clustering configuration and actual benefits of a table, including the number of benefited jobs, saved CU hours, and shuffle data volume. Returns the current configuration of the table even if no benefit records exist
description_zh: 查询表的当前聚簇配置和实际收益，包括受益作业数量、节省的 CU 时和 Shuffle 数据量。无收益记录时仍可返回表的当前配置
kebab_example: aliyun maxcompute get-auto-cluster-info --project analytics_prod --table order_detail --api-version 2022-01-04 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetAutoClusterInfo

parameters.help_en: The name of the MaxCompute project
parameters.name: project

parameters.help_en: The name of the MaxCompute table
parameters.name: table

parameters.help_en: The scope of benefit statistics. A value of false indicates that the daily benefits from the latest batch of data are retrieved. A value of true indicates that the cumulative benefits after clustering is applied are calculated. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 收益统计范围。false 表示取最新一批数据中的当日收益，true 表示累计统计聚簇应用后的收益。默认为 false
parameters.name: since_created

parameters.help_en: The name of the schema to which the table belongs
parameters.help_zh: 表所属的 Schema 名称
parameters.name: schema
